messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the postmortem: ETL lag on 2026-03-12 caused delayed spans and bad rollups. we need owners, short ETAs, and verification so this doesn't recur.

ajay: I can own detection + dashboards. will add a per-deploy span-reconciliation panel and a missing_span counter. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

dave: pipeline fix here. root cause looks like a windowing regression after the reorder PR. plan: revert in staging, add an ordering integration test, run targeted backfill for 03/12-03/14. ETA: Wed COB.

sasha: alerts + CI gating. adding a Prom alert: median_etl_processing_ms > 120s for 5m and a postdeploy synthetic that checks span counts. will gate the integration test in CI. ETA: Tue AM.

obs-bot: Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/pms/ETL-2026-03-12  span-drop-rate spike x3.

maria: please post PR links, add a short runbook entry for oncall triage, and note a possible recurring pattern (ordering-touching deploys ~6-8 weeks).

ajay: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/mon/pulls/425  added sql to surface bad batches.

dave: backfill PR/job: https://git.redwood/etl/pulls/398, job bf-20260315-11. staging revert commit: ab12cd.

sasha: CI PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/81  adds synthetic run + postdeploy validation. runbook snippet: "on span-drop spike -> pause deploys, run backfill, notify #incidents & oncall."

maria: ownership recap: Ajay (detection/dashboard) EOD tomorrow; Dave (pipeline+backfill) Wed COB; Sasha (alerts+CI) Tue AM. I'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm progress. Close once dashboards merged, backfill completes, CI gating in place, and runbook live. :white_check_mark:
